question: What happens when right-minded knowledge is taken from Vaishnava sources?
premises: knowledge is taken from Vaishnava and other sources
the right-minded one takes Shaiva knowledge
difference-mode remains in Shiva-knowledge even when heard
inference: borrowed knowledge still leaves a residual difference in Shiva-knowledge
uncertainties: śrute@pyalam is a sandhi phrase with compressed meaning
plain_english: Likewise, from Vaishnava and other sources, the right-minded one takes Shaiva knowledge; even when heard, a single mode of difference remains in Shiva-knowledge.
